name: Refinery-petrochemical integration (FCC propylene, HS-FCC)
principle: Refineries shift FCC conditions and catalyst to make more propylene and other light olefins for petrochemicals. High-severity FCC (HS-FCC) uses a downflow reactor, about 600 degC, short contact time and a catalyst-to-oil ratio above 30, which gives conversion above 80 wt% and about 20 wt% propylene in pilot tests with ZSM-5 additive on untreated VGO.
